text:
Anya: Heads-up — ran into onboarding friction with the sampleapp. Error surface is confusing, and the auth retry path keeps looping for me. Joining notes here so we can decide a short-term fix and a longer-term ergonomic shape.
Ben: Ugh, yes. Seen that too. Can you paste the raw error JSON?
Anya: Paste below — this is from the JS SDK (v0.9.3) when token refresh failed:
```json\n{\n  \"error\": \"internal_error\",\n  \"message\": \"something went wrong\",\n  \"code\": 500\n}\n```
Anya: No hint whether it's auth vs service vs rate-limit, so the sampleapp retries indefinitely.
Zoe: For onboarding, we need three things: typed error classes (AuthError, RateLimitError, TransientError), clear human message, and a boolean or hint for `shouldRetry`.
Sam: Agree. Minimal SDK change: map 401/403 -> AuthError (no retry), 429 -> RateLimitError (exponential backoff), 5xx -> TransientError (retryable but with cap). Also include `retryAfter` when available.
Ben: This mapping makes sense. Small bikeshed: should AuthError carry whether refresh token is possible? e.g., AuthError.refreshable = true/false. Sampleapp can then trigger interactive reauth only when true.
Anya: Love that. In my case token was expired and refresh failed, so refreshable=false would have prevented the loop.
Zoe: Implementation sketch for JS SDK error class shape:
```js
class RedwoodError extends Error {
  constructor({type, code, message, meta}) { super(message); this.type = type; this.code = code; this.meta = meta; }
}

// types: 'auth', 'rate_limit', 'transient', 'client'
```
Zoe: And an API-level contract: error response includes `type` and optional `retryable` and `retry_after_ms`. Eg: `{ type: "auth", message: "token expired", refreshable: true }`
Sam: For server side, runtime can set that shape. But we must be careful: we don't want to expose internal strings. Use an enum in the payload and document it.
sdk-bot: deploy:staging — new small change to error envelope landed in staging (PR #4021) :white_check_mark:
Ben: Nice. Can we make the client auto-detect refreshable via headers if meta.refresh_token==true? Also surface a concise user-facing message for sampleapp like: "Sign in again — your session expired" (instead of raw token error).
Anya: Yes, UX copy matters. The sampleapp should show a toast with friendly text and a link to re-auth. We should also include a telemetry tag `error_surface:onboarding_sampleapp` so we can measure improvement.
Zoe: Action items: 1) SDK owners (Ben/Sam) add typed errors + `retryable` enum to response contract (ETA 1 week), 2) sampleapp (Anya) update onboarding toast & stop retry loop (ETA 3 days), 3) Docs: quick copy examples + mapping table (owner Zoe, ETA 1 week).
Ben: I'll open the SDK PR with the types and an opt-in flag `enableStructuredErrors` so we can roll it out.
Sam: I'll wire `retryAfter` semantics and ensure exponential jittered backoff lives in our default retry policy. Default max attempts = 4.
Anya: I'll patch sampleapp to check `error.type` and `error.meta?.refreshable` before retrying. If refreshable=false -> surface UI prompt, stop retry.
Zoe: We should also add a small e2e test in onboarding flow that simulates 401+refresh-fail to avoid regressions.
Ben: Quick question re: status code mapping: do we treat 422 as client (no retry) or specific validation error class?
Anya: For onboarding UX 422 should be ValidationError so we can highlight the offending field. Not a generic client error.
Sam: Agreed. We'll add `validation` type.
Zoe: OK. Anything else?
Anya: One more: include `raw_code` in meta for debugging but not flood user-facing message. E.g., meta.raw = {service: 'auth', errorId: 'abcd-1234'}.
Ben: Sounds good. I'll add tests + changelog and ping infra to add `error_surface:onboarding_sampleapp` to release notes.
sdk-bot: ci/build — tests passed on branch error-structs (6/6) :tada:
Zoe: Great. Thanks team. We'll reconvene in three days to check metrics. :thumbsup:
